tr_h_list: When a user attempts to log in, the system shall request additional authentication factors.
When a user attempts to log in with an invalid password, the system shall not request additional authentication factors.
When a user attempts to log in with an invalid username, the system shall display an error message.
When a user requests password recovery, the system shall send an email notification with reset instructions.
When a user requests password recovery without an associated email address, the system shall display an error message.
When a user requests password recovery with an invalid account, the system shall not send an email notification.
When a user selects the manual sign-out option, the system shall terminate the current session.
When a user selects the manual sign-out option while multiple sessions are active, the system shall terminate all current sessions.
When a user selects the manual sign-out option while not logged in, the system shall display an error message.
When an account is locked due to failed sign-in attempts, the system shall display a notification indicating the account lock.
When an incorrect password is entered five times, the system shall temporarily suspend account access.
When user clicks sign-in button, the system shall display account dashboard within 3 seconds.
When user clicks recover password link, the system shall send recovery email within 2 minutes.
When user enters new password, the system shall update password within 1 second.
When user clicks sign-out button, the system shall log out user within 1 second.
When user enters incorrect password five times, the system shall lock account within 1 second.
When account is locked, the system shall display error message within 1 second.
When user recovers password, the system shall unlock account within 1 second.
When user changes password, the system shall update account settings within 1 second.
When user signs out, the system shall clear session data within 1 second.
When user signs in, the system shall create new session within 1 second.
When user attempts to sign in with locked account, the system shall display error message within 1 second.
When user enters incorrect password, the system shall display error message within 1 second.
